headline.funnel_interpretation: Egger’s test is generally not recommended when fewer than 10 studies are available.
headline.results_interpretation: The pooled analysis of 3 studies yielded an effect size of 0.95 (95% CI: 0.85–1.07), indicating no statistically significant association between dietary protein intake and bladder cancer. Although the point estimate suggests a potential inverse relationship, the confidence interval includes the null. These findings were accompanied by low heterogeneity (I² = 19.68%), indicating consistent findings across the included studies.
